name: (02) Thaumaturgy: Spirit Thaumaturgy — 3 Advanced — Spirit Eyes

system.description:
You part the veil between the quick and the dead, turning your gaze upon the restless spirits that linger unseen at the edges of the living world, and open your lips to speak with those the living cannot hear.

You may attempt to see and communicate with wraiths in the area. A successful Mental Challenge versus the wraith is required before you are able to see or communicate with it. You may then commune with the ghost for five minutes for every Mental Trait you expend.
